subject: Data eviction windows & deletion SLAs — proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — bespoke retention / deletion guarantees

Hi Ben + Laura,

Thanks for the call earlier. Pegasus Health has two quick but critical asks as we move toward finalizing the order form:

1) Residency: all patient-facing inference (tokens & logs) must be stored and processed only in the US East region.
2) Retention & deletion windows: we need configurable retention windows by data class: PII-derived tokens retained for no more than 180 days; telemetry/metrics up to 365 days.
3) Post-contract deletion: certified deletion within 30 calendar days of contract termination for PII-derived artifacts, with an audit record that proves deletion.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to these as bespoke SLA/order form language? If not full commitment, we need explicit alternative wording and timeline. Procurement would like the proposed redline by EOD Friday.

Attaching a short list of regulatory constraints we need considered (see link in follow-up).

Best,
Samira
Head of Procurement
Pegasus Health

Attachment: peg_reqs_summary.pdf (PDF, 34 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — bespoke retention / deletion guarantees

Samira — thanks for laying this out. We can absolutely run everything in us-east for your tenant and provide order-form language for per-class retention windows.

Quick notes / proposed commitments:
- Residency: Confirmed — all persisted artifacts for your tenant will be pinned to us-east (physical region-level routing).
- Retention windows (order form language draft):
  • PII-derived tokens: configurable retention default 180 days (customer may request shorter)
  • Telemetry/metrics: up to 365 days (default 365)
- Post-contract deletion: Redwood will execute data deletion procedures and provide a signed deletion certificate and log export. Typical turnaround for deletion + certificate: 30 calendar days; for large-scale archival data, we will provide a status report and phased completion plan.

I attached a short draft proposal for the order form (pegasus-data-retention-proposal-v1.pdf) with redline-friendly text. Two items I flagged for internal review: 
1) What counts as "PII-derived tokens" vs. general artifacts for billing/analytics? (We should avoid over-broad definitions.)
2) Certificate format: legal wants something auditable (signed JSON record with KMS key id).

Laura — cc'ing you to pull in legal/sales ops for suggested wording. Samira: if this looks close, we'll iterate and push a more formal v2 with the DocuSign-ready order form.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pegasus-data-retention-proposal-v1.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal — peg retention redlines (ask: legal + product input)

Laura / Neha — looping you both in. See Samira's requirements and my proposed commitments below. Key open items:

- Definition boundary: we need product to confirm what we classify as "PII-derived tokens". Is it any user-identifying embedding/kv pair, or only those where the input contained PHI? This affects both retention and audit scope.
- Deletion certification: Legal prefers a signed proof record referencing KMS key id and deletion job id. Product: can you produce an export of the deletion log with a signed timestamp?
- Edge cases: backups / snapshots — what is Redwood's retention in disaster recovery copies? Procurement will expect either included deletion or an explicit exclusion in the order form.

I marked suggested wording in the v1 PDF and highlighted the clause for "backup and snapshot exceptions." Please advise by EOD Thursday so we can send v2 to Pegasus.

Thanks,
Ben

On Tue, Jun 22, 2026 at 11:03 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samira — thanks for laying this out....

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — bespoke retention / deletion guarantees

Ben — thanks, that directionally matches what we need. A few clarifications and requests from our side after legal review:

1) Please make the order form definition for "PII-derived tokens" explicit: "tokens, embeddings, or other processed artifacts that contain or can be used to reconstruct an individual’s identity or medical information."
2) Backups/snapshots: Pegasus requires deletion in backups within 90 days of the primary deletion event for PII artifacts.
3) KMS/HSM: we require a field in the order form specifying KMS key-id used for the deletion certificate and the ability to rotate keys with a 30-day notice.

I've attached our annotated SOW with inline comments: Pegasus_SOW_comments.docx. We're prepared to sign once the v2 incorporates the backup window and the certificate schema. Also requesting DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks,
Samira

Attachment: Pegasus_SOW_comments.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final v2 proposal and next steps (DocuSign ready)

Samira — attaching v2 (pegasus-data-retention-proposal-v2.pdf) which incorporates the items you and legal requested:

- Explicit definition for "PII-derived tokens" (see Section 1.2).
- Backup/snapshot deletion window: PII artifacts purged from backups within 90 days of primary deletion event.
- Deletion certificate: Redwood will provide a signed JSON certificate that includes deletion job id, timestamp, and KMS key id; certificates are stored in our audit logs and delivered as a downloadable artifact.
- Residency: tenant pinned to us-east for all persisted artifacts.
- SLA language: certified deletion completion target: 30 calendar days from contract termination; partial completion reporting at 7/14/21 day milestones for large datasets.

We can produce the DocuSign envelope once you confirm the redline on Section 3 (backup exceptions). Link to the preliminary envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-PEGA-0892

Next steps: please confirm by reply-if-ok and I will route to Sales Ops to open the DocuSign envelope and to Legal to finalize certificate format.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pegasus-data-retention-proposal-v2.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)
